idea-plugin.name: Env Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Env Switcher — free, non-commercial open source plugin.

Switch named environment profiles inside the IDE with one click.

  • Edit profiles and variables in Settings → Tools → Env Switcher
  • Copy profiles or import existing .env files into the settings editor
  • Load profiles from env-profiles.json in the project root
  • Write the active profile into a generated .env file
  • Inject the active profile into Java and local Python Run Configurations at runtime (Python Community is optional)
  • Show the current profile on the status bar

在 IDE 中一键切换命名环境配置：读取项目根目录 env-profiles.json， 将当前环境写入 .env，提供设置界面编辑和复制配置、导入已有 .env 文件，运行时注入 Java 和本地 Python Run Configuration（需 Python Community 插件），并在状态栏显示。 本插件为非商业开源软件。

Source: GitHub · License: Apache-2.0
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.0
  • Copy environment profiles with independent variables and automatic unique naming
  • Import UTF-8 .env files as new profiles; Apply saves changes and Reset discards them
  • Support dotenv comments, quotes, multiline values and export prefixes, with line-numbered validation errors
0.4.0
  • Add project settings for editing profiles and variables, with validation and external-change protection
  • Refresh the active environment after settings changes
  • Add optional runtime environment injection for local Python Run Configurations
0.3.2
  • Replace the deprecated DynamicBundle constructor for IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 compatibility
0.3.1
  • Fix the environment chooser not appearing when no focused editor or context component is available
  • Refresh generated .env files asynchronously to avoid event dispatch thread violations
  • Reload profiles on project startup before restoring the last selected environment
0.3.0
  • Inject the active profile into Java Run Configurations at runtime (does not rewrite saved configs)
0.2.0
  • Persist last selected profile in the workspace and restore it (including .env) on project open
0.1.0
  • Initial release: profile switching, .env export, status bar widget
